title: Resource failure rate
sqlTemplate: select count(*) filter (where type = 'resource' and (resource_status_code >= 400 or resource_status_code = 0)) as failed_resources, count(*) filter (where type = 'resource') as resources, case when count(*) filter (where type = 'resource') = 0 then null else count(*) filter (where type = 'resource' and (resource_status_code >= 400 or resource_status_code = 0)) * 1.0 / count(*) filter (where type = 'resource') end as resource_failure_rate from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}}
emptyDataSemantics: denominator (resources) = 0 -> resource_failure_rate is SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never 0.
